result.card: Updates documentation to register implemented standards BIP 389 (multipath descriptors) and BIP 394 (rawtr). It adds entries for both BIPs in doc/bips.md and links BIP 394 next to the rawtr() expression in doc/descriptors.md. This addresses out-of-date documentation for features implemented in v24.0 and v29.0 after the corresponding BIP specifications were formally assigned and merged.
